tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig thos pa'i rgya mtsho rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba bzhugs so// gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga ma chag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob nas/ /de'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bir+wa pa ḍoṃ bi he ru ka bī ra ḍi pa/ gaṃ bhi ra ma ti/ niska lang ka de waḥ ra wen+t+ra/ chag chos rje dpal/ g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge/ shong lo tsā ba blo brtan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel/ de la bdag sa skya lo tsā bas thob bo/ /gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bir+wa pas mdzad pa chag lo'i 'gyur/ 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba rnams bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs chag 'gyur yang dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bir+wa pas mdzad pa dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur rnams kyi lung thob ba'o/ /gong du smos pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsan yig bzhin bris pa yin la/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig thos pa rgya mtsho dang yong grags ltar na/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshedaḥ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro maḥ bir+wa paḥ ḍoṃ bi he ru kaḥ bī ra ḍi pa/ gaṃ bhi ra ma ti/ niska laṃ ka de waḥ ra wen+t+raḥ chag lo tsā ba/ go lung pa mdo sde dpalaḥ shong lo tsā ba blo brtanaḥ bla ma lo tsā ba chen po mchog ldanaḥ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bya ster ba byang chub rin chenaḥ ra ga brag pa shākya seng ge chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyalaḥ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang poḥ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshanaḥ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog chos 'phelaḥ

de la sa skya lo tsā ba bdag gis thob boḥ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang rnam par dag pa thob pa'i brgyud pa niḥ rdo rje 'chang ཿ 'phags pa 'jam dpalaḥ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabasaḥ mar me mdzad bzang poḥ dpal 'dzin/ nā ro pa/ a s+d+yu la badz+raḥ bla ma bha ro phyag rdumaḥ rje mal lo tsā ba/ rje sa skya pa chen poḥ rje btsun bsod nams rtse moḥ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshanaḥ gan pa ston daraḥ gan pa so stonaḥ gan pa chos rgyalaḥ gan pa rin rgyalaḥ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang poḥ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang poḥ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshanaḥkun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel/ de la bdag sa skya lo tsā bas thob bo/ /bya spyod kyi skor la mi 'khrugs pa bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub paḥ 'jam dpalaḥ ye shes snying poḥ ye shes zhi baḥ sangs rgyas zhi baḥ sangs rgyas gsang baḥ ku sa li che baḥ ku sa li chung baḥ gser gling paḥ jo bo rje a ti sha go mi sgom chenaḥ kyi nor dz+nyā naḥ snyag ldom bu baḥ spug thams cad grags pa mkhyen paḥ chos kyi rgyal mtshanaḥ bya rin chen 'odaḥ glo chen sangs rgyas srasaḥ bde ba can pa ye shes mgonaḥ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshanaḥ mkhan chen shes rdor baḥ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā naḥ sa bzang 'phags paḥ rje kun dga' bzang poḥ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phelaḥ de la lo tsā ba bdag gi thob bo/ /'di'i sgrub thabasaḥ dkyil chog sbyin sreg rnams dze tā ris mdzad paḥ dī paṃ ka ra shrī ñdzā na dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos 'gyur mdzad pa rnams thos soḥ /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ /bla chen bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ e pa mkhon ston/bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ /byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog 'phel/ de la bdag sa skya lo tsās thos so/ /yang na/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog 'phel/ de la bdag gis thob bo/ /sgrub thabs dkyil chog 'chi bslu dang / bstod pa rnams dze tā ris mdzad pa/ lce dga' ba'i dpal gyi 'gyur ba mdzad pa thob/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i khrid byin rlabs rgyud kyi bshad bka' sogs thob pa'i rnam grangs dang brgyud pa'i rim pa brjod na/ thog mar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i thugs kyi snying khu rje btsun sa skya ba rim par byon pa rnams kyi nyams bzhes lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa lan gnyis kyi bar du zhus pa'i skor la/ dang po sems bskyed/ gzhi smin byed rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang lan gnyis thob nas brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ se mkhar chung pa/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/

chos rje sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ chos rje sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ yang na/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bdag med ma'i lus dkyil gyis byin rlabs/ lam dus kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni gong dang 'dra'o/ /yang na kye rdo rje yab kyi dbang bka'i brgyud pa lugs gzhan ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje brag phug pa man gong bzhin no/ /yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ aṣ+ṭī bzlas lung / bzhi bshad dang / byad bzlog dang bcas pa'i brgyad pa ni/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ /bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man sngar bzhin/ /gsung ngag gi nyams 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bar dbang bka' dang 'dra/ des tshogs sgom rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje brag phug pa/ de la chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma blo gros brtan pa gnyis gas gsan/ de gnyis ka la bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de nas bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi nang nas tshig nyung la don rgyas pa'i lam 'bras gnyag ma dkar chag gi nang bzhin tshang mar thob pa la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i bsdus don/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ gdan sogs/ lam la sogs pa chos nyi shu la/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ /bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma'i skabs su/ 'chi ltas 'khrul 'khor 'chi slu dang bcas pa/ bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i mda' kha ma/ gsang dbang gi skabs su thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/

shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi ba'i 'da' kha ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi'i gdams ngag go /lam dus kyi dbang / tshad ma bzhi/ gdams ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa/ grib ma khrus kyis sel ba/ tsha tsha'i sel ba/ thig le bsrung ba dang yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su rlung gi sbyor ba bdun gyi lam khrid pa/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ 'das pa'i lam la gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i skabs su dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ /sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs/ de thams cad kyi don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ de dag las 'phros pa la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtsa 'grel gnyis/ gdan sogs la 'phros nas dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba ste de la dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur ba/ lam sogs nyi shu la 'phros nas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa dam tshig la 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa/ byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa/ bsrung ba sum cu dang man ngag gi gnad bdun cu la 'phros nas gegs sel lo/ /de la yi ge bzhi ste/ bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dang las dang po ba dang thun mong gi chos bdun te lam rgyas pa dang / rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bring po dang / rang gi gzhung cung zad yod pa/ /bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa lam bsdus pa te/ de ltar na lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / lam de dag rnal 'byor pas nyams su blangs pas rtogs tshad bskyed pa'i phyir/ lam gyi gzhung shing bzhi dang /

rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga yod de/ gzhung shing chen po bzhi ni/ gang zag gzhung ji lta bzhin du bkri ba'i gzhung shing / man ngag gi gnad drug gi bkri pa'i gzhung shing / brtson 'grus can man ngag gi gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i gzhung shing / gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum du bkri ba'i gzhung shing ngo / /rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga ni/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ rtogs pa bskyed pa'i dpe chung la/ 'chi ltas kyi 'khor lo gnyis/ rtsa'i dpe chung / bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i dpe chung / gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe chung rnams ni gang zag tha ma'i lam gyi man ngag yin la/ 'bring gi lam dam tshig dang sdom pa ni de dag gi seb tshags su 'du'o/ /gang zag rab kyi man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge de thams cad kyi rgyab brten lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang / zhib tu sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang / bla ma bod dang rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus rnams so/ /de dag gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shri/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ yang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ gzhung bshad man ngag gter mdzod/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung zhing sbas don gsal ba/ gnad bcu gcig gi bkri ba'i gzhung zhing gnad kyi sgo 'byed/ gnad drug bkri ba'i gzhung zhing gnad kyi lde mig dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis bkri ba'i gzhung shing nyung ngu rnams gsal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhal shes kyi yi ge dang bcas ba/

lus dkyil gyi dbang mchog lam dus kyi dbang ste/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam 'bras pod nag tu grags pa dang gsal byed nyer gnyis la sogs pa gnyag ma yig chung rnams dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa budha shrī/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje/ gzhung bshad dmar ba/ zin bris bar ston ma/ bar ston gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ /sgang ston shes 'bum/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge yang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ rje btsun kun dka' bzang po/ /chos rje mus chen pa/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ des bdag la'o/ /lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ khrid gyi dkar chag gi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ man ngag gsang ba bcu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis man 'dra/ tshar gsum khug pa yan lag drug dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung ba/ mkhas grub chos rje/

zhang byang she/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra/ yang na tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ zhag chen pa/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje mus chen man 'dra/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa/ nyams chung ba/ bar chad gsum sel che ba/ chung ba/ gegs sel gces bsdus/ gsang bdun ma/ gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ gleng gzhi ma/ brda tshig brgyud/ dbang gi rab dbye/ gsang dbang gi rab dbye/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge phyag rgya chen po'i dbye ba rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ brda don gsal ba'i khrid yig byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje pa/ lung phu pa/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ bla ma kun bsod/ brag phug pa chen po/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra/ rnam 'byor dbang byug gi chos bzhi las lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom rin po che chos rje nyan chen pa/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra/ bir+wa pa'i byin rlabs/ bsrung ba'i man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje brag phug pa yan gong dang 'dra ba las chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ lam sbas bshad kyi thugs rdo rje'i khri/ 'khrul 'khor/ grub chen bcu/ phra mo brgyad dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

bir bsrung dang 'dra'o/ de'i 'khrul 'khor so gnyis kyis brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'od/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ sbas bshad pho brang lnga'i khrid 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ lam skor la sgrol ma dkar mo'i byin gyis rlabs shing rdo rje bdag med mas dbang dang gdam ngag bstan pa slob dpon ngag gi dbang byug grags pas mdzad pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag rje btsun gyi khrid yig byin rlabs dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ de gnyis la jo bo a mo gha badz+ras gsan/ de la 'brog mi/ de man lam 'bras dang 'dra'o/ /tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa grub chen tog rtse pas saṃbhu ṭa'i rgyud la brten nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa lngas lam rdzogs pa'i khrid yig lo rgyus dang bcas pa rtse mos mdzad pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rta mchog bir+wa pā dang / in+t+ra bhū ti/ lak+ṣ+mī pā da/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ ghun ḍha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos kyi pa/ bzang po'i zhabs/ rtog rtse pa/ bhu ṣa ṇa pa/ dha ma pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ /de'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'od shāka la ru ba/ ye shes mgon/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī man 'dra'o/ /chos rje sa paṇa yan gdams ngag gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o/ /rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo ār+ya de wa'i don du gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du sems thag bcad pa'i gdams ngag rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ dge slong nag po zhabs/ tsan+d+ra kīrti/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras dang 'dra'o/ /bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa grub chen nag po spyod pa bas 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i gtum mos lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i gdams ngag rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus spal zhabs/ dza laṃ dha ri pa/ gan po spyod pa/ shrī dha ra/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ /yang nag po pas mdzad pa'i/ rlung yon po srang ba'i khrid yig gi brgyud rim yang gong ma dang 'dra'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi mngon sum du dbang bskur bas 'bras bu grub pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis gsang ba 'dus pa la brten nas mdzad pa'i phyag rgyas lam rdzogs pa'i gdams ngag lo rgyus dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dang po dpal sde'i zhal snga nas/ de bzhin du yang tshangs pa dang / bram ze mo ni rdo rje grub/ de nas shrī badz+ra bo dhi rgyal/ dpe yi slob dpon de'i phyi ma/ gos bral zhal snga de bzhin no/ /dpal ldan dz+nyā na bo dhi rgyal/ de bzhin shrī yo bo dhi dang / slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang / ḍoṃ bi'i zhal snga de bzhin no/ /yan lag bar ma dpal lha mo/ /bung ba'i pad+ma de bzhin no/ /dur khrod du ni ki lar bzhugs/ lha lcam lak+ṣ+mī de bzhin no/ /bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin/ zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang / dpal bde ba chen po/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ dpal tshangs pa'i zhabs/ bram ze grub pa'i rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ slob dpon u ma pa'i zhabs/ slob dpon gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dz+nyā na bo dhi/ shrī yo bo dhi/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/

ḍoṃ bi he ru ka yan lag bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ rgyal po in+t+ra bhū ti chung ba/ de'i slob ma bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ de la kha che shes rab gsang bas gsan/ de la 'brog mi ste/ de man lam 'bras dang 'dra'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ an+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ shes rab gsang ba'o/ /yang sku tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ pad+ma badz+ra gyis brtag gnyis la brten nas mdzad pa'i bskyed rim zab pa'i tshul dgu/ rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu/ khrid yig rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bi la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mī/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ /yang ra ḍa zhes bya ba'i yul du/ sku lus 'di nyid la dngos grub brnyes pa ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas brtag gnyis la brten nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa lhan cig skyes pa grub pa zhes bya ba'i khrid yig rlung sbyor gyi thabs dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ḍoṃ bhi ba/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ /sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa ni/ rdo rje gdan gyi shar sgo mkhas pa shān+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ dbus kyi ka chen dz+nyā na shrī dang rin chen rdo rje gnyis/ /nub sgo ba shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa ste gsum gyis bar chad gsum sel/ lho sgo ba ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ byang sgo ba nā ro ta pa'i phyag rgya chen po sdug bsngal gsum sel te/ des na shān+ti pa/ dz+nyā na shrī/ rin chen rdo rje/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ nā ro pa/ de drug so so la 'brog mi'i gsan/

de yang bar chad gsum sel ni 'brog mis se rog gnyis la/ des gnyos la/ de nas yer ba sgom seng / grub thob lha 'bar/ kha rag sgom pa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung ba/ mkhas grub chos rje/ zhang byang she/ chos rje bla ma/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje bud+dha shrī/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po man sngar dang 'dra'o/ /gnyug ma dran gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma shang pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ lung phu ba man gong bzhin no/ /sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ nā ro pa/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa/ sa chen man 'dra'o/ /mdo rgyud bsre ba'i brgyud pa ni/ shīn+ta pa/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung pa/ sa chen man 'dra'o/ /lam 'bras sras don mar grags pa thob pa'i brgyud ba ni/ brag phug ba yan khrid dang 'dra ba las/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ brag phug pa dkon rgyal/ /grub chen bud+dha shrī/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug bla ma chos rje/ yang na/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje mus pa chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel ba/ de la bdag gis thos so/ /bla ma'i rnam thar thor bur gnas pa rnams dang / pod dmar mar grags pa dkar chag bzhin dang / zhang bya ru ba/ klan dkar ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ nyan chen pa/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan rnams kyi mdzad pa'i khrid yig rnams thos te/ rje bla ma chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje la gsan gsung ngo / de ltar na gsung ngag rin po che'i man ngag dkar chag tu 'bri ba dang mi 'bri ba 'ga' dang bcas te yongs su rdzogs par thob bo/ /lam 'bras chos 'byung chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i kha skong dang bcas pa'i lung yang thos so/ /grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas bkral ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab mo rim lnga'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ra pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ gu h+ya pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phaṃ thing pa/ klog kya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyi blo gros grags/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bo dong rin po che/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ rin po che khro phu ba/ bsod nams seng ge dpal bzang po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge gnyan mkhar ba bkra shis bzang po/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab mo rim bzhi'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri pa/ lu i pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya ba/ mal lo/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ mkhas grub bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /rim bzhi lam slong / khrid yig phran rnams dang bcas pa dang / chos rje bsod nams seng ge bas mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi lung rnams thos so/ /bde mchog dkar po'i khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ /'khor lo bde mchog paṇa chen shākya shrī/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

rin po che grags tshul ba/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /dpyal a mo ghas mdzad pa'i khrid yig lhan skyes pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta'i lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ khrid yig brgyud pa gsum pa/ yang khrid yig gcig rnams thos so/ /rdzogs rim zab mo shin tu spros med kyi khrid thob nas brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ bir+wa pa/ ḍoṃ bi pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ /blo bzang snying po/ dar+paṇa ā tsar+ya/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ /bla ma sa pa/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ spros med kyi byin rlabs/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa/ bdud rtsi lnga byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga gnyis bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ glo bo lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i khrid yig spros med mdzes rgyan rnams thos so/ /ku ru kul+le/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ tshogs kyi bdag po rnams kyi rjes gnang thob nas/ ku ru kul+le'i lo rgyus rjes gnang gi yi ge sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i man ngag che chung gsum/ sgrub thabs rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ 'dod rgyal la/ sngags kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ /sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ dbang gi zhal gdams nyams su blang bde ba sa paṇa gyi mdzad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas/ bzlas lung / gtor ma'i zhal gdams/

drag po'i las sbyor/ 'khor lo bri ba'i man ngag las bzhi'i zin bris/ gsang bsgrub/ rin chen bsgrub pa'i man ngag zhi rgyas drag gsum la kha bsgyur/ sbyin sreg bstod pa/ mchod 'bul/ rtags yig rten 'brel gyi cho ga brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ sgrub thabs chos rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag gi lo rgyus/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs de paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ sgrub yig 'phags pas mdzad pa/ dbang rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg tshogs bdag gi gzungs rnams kyi brgyud pa ni chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug bla ma chos rje/ yang na/ chos rje bsod nams seng ge bla ma chos rje la bdag sa skya lo tsā bas thos so/ /spyir rgya gar na sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gsum yod pa las/ rgyas pa sgrub thabs kun btus sam rgya mtsho zhes grags pa sgrub thabs nyis brgya lhag pa bzhugs pa bod yul du chos rje sa paṇa gyi dngos slob yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bar pa phyed dang nyis brgya pa zhes grags pa pa tshab kyis bsgyur ba/ bsdus pa brgya rtsar grags pa ba ri bas bsgyur ba 'di rnams yin pa las/ 'dir sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i rnam grangs ni thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo slob dpon bha wa skan+dhas mdzad pa/ yang brtan pa'i 'khor lo rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ /tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na lha lnga dkar po slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gyis mdzad pa/ yang a ra pa tsa na dkar po lha lnga slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor lnga pa/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gnyis pa/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal po rol pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod nas gsungs pa'i 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyis bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal/

'jam dpal ye shes kyi sbyor ba zer ba'i dmigs pa cig 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs gsung gi dbang phyug mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pa/ 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo/ /'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal drug pa/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po phyag gnyis pa/ yang gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ 'jam dpal slob dpon pū dza na bha tras mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ khar sa pā ṇi lha lnga rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gnyis pa lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ ha ri ha ri la zhon pa/ yang ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug lha dgu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i spyan ras gzigs dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo gtso 'khor gsum pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ u rgyan gyi 'od zer can/ rtog pa las byung ba'i 'od zer can/ rtog pa las byung ba'i 'od zer can dkar mo/ /mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can/ u rgyan gyi 'od zer can lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ yang u rgyan gyi 'od zer can/ tsun+da'i sgrub thabs/ 'dzam ser tsaṇ+ḍa go mis mdzad pa/ dzaṃ nag dga' ba byin gyis mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma/ khro gnyer can/ byams pa/ sher phyin dkar mo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa/ yang sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs dge 'dun byin gyi sras kyis mdzad pa/ shes phyin gyi sgrub thabs/

yang sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ mdor bsdus pa'i sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs pra bha ka ra kī rtis mdzad pa/ yang mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs gzhon nu sbas pas mdzad pa/ yang gtum po chen po/ hūm̐ mdzad ri khrod ma/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ /bgegs dgra ral gcig ma/ dug sel ma/ rig byed ma/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yang rig byed ma/ u rgyan nas 'byung ba'i ku ru kul+le'i 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs sa ra has mdzad pa/ nor rgyun ma dang jam+bha la la gnod sbyin pho mo nyer bzhis bskor ba/ rgya nag sgrol ma rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma gtso 'khor bcu gcig gshed dmar gyi gtso bo yab yum/ so so 'brang ma/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ rma bya chen mo/ /stong chen rab 'joms/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ bsil ba'i tshal/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ rdo rje ghan+dha ri/ gur mgon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog stobs po che/ gdugs dkar can/ rta mgrin/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa/ bdag med ma/ yang bdag med ma/ gser mdog can gyi sher phyin/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can/ rdo rje phag mo/ /rig byed ma/ sgrol ma dkar mo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ de ltar na sgrub thabs bsdus par grags pa de dag gi lung dang rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/

rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje btsun dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i lha tshogs de dag gi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i rnam grangs ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi chen po ku mud ta 'byung ba'i blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyi man ngag gi cho ga dang / dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ yang dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ za ma tog bkod pa'i nang nas phyung ba yi ge drug pa sham thab can gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ kha sar pa ṇi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs slob dpon rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ po tā la kha sar pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ kha sar pa ṇa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bde byed kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs a nu pa ma rak+ṣi tas cung zad rgyas par mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta a wa dhū ti dpal ldan 'jigs med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i grub thabs/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang phyug ha la hā la hā la'i sgrub thabs/ ha la hā la'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/

pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gis sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang gi sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lhag par dbang du bya ba'i cho ga 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgrin pa sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ pad+ma'i phyag gi gzungs nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa sran ma ma sha'i zhal gyi gzungs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'phags pa bhū ga ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shū n+ya tā sa mā dhi badz+ra pa da'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bha wa skan+dhas mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal ngag gis rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dpal yid bzhin nor bus mdzad pa/ dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ yang ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'phags pa ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shes rab 'phel ba'i gter/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan 'phrog byed 'joms mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom pa'i man ngag a ra pa tsa na 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/

dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs kyi dbang du bya ba'i cho ga ngag gi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rgyal po chen po rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ bung ba myos pa'i sgrub thabs/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa so so nas bsdus pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag shes rab 'khor lo'i dngos grub mchog gi sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dung gi ting nge 'dzin 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge gcig pa'i rab tu sbyor ba'i sgrub thabs/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs cho ga dang bcas pa 'od zer 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ mchog sbyin sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang byed sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs tshul mi 'dra ba gsum las gcig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon chos 'byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med kyi snying po'i rgyud las 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtog pa gsungs pa ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs/ don thams cad rab tu sbyin pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/

de'i gzungs/ yang dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i rigs sngags sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i rtog pa/ dzaṃ gu li'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ de'i man ngag yang sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gnas brtan dpe med kyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag chen po'i rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon brtag pa'i rdo rje mdzad pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gi slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ sgron ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs che chung mi 'dra ba lnga las gcig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ tsun+ta'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ rtog pa las byung ba'i 'od zer can phyag bcu ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can ser mo phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ o ḍi ya na'i 'od zer can phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ o ḍi ya na'i 'od zer can dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ 'od zer can dmar mo phyag bcu ma'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i jag bcing / rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/

'od zer can pi tsu ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ de'i gzungs klag pa'i man ngag ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyi bus mdzad pa/ yang sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma 'phel gyis mdzad pa/ gser mdog can gyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ yang gser mdog can gyi sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rdo rje pi waṃ ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags ma khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa las phyung ba ku ru kul+le'i grub thabs/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa las phyung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i dbang du byed pa'i man ngag yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ u rgyan nas byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kyai rdo rje'i rim pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kyai rdor gyi rgyud nas byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ rig byed ma phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rig byed ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/

de'i man ngag gi rim pa/ rig byed ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kul+le'i las kyi sbyor ba/ rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ gdugs dkar can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje tsā tsi ka'i sgrub thabs/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ stong chen mo/ /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ rma bya chen mo/ /bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus/ phyir bzlog ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje ghaṇ+ḍha ri'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga rdo rje lcags sgrogs kyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros kyi mdzad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ de'i gzungs kyi man ngag phag mo'i sgrub thabs a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi tas 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dzaṃ bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs/ dzaṃ bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gsum/ ser po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ ser po lha pho brgyad/ mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ de la chu rgyun du dbul ba'i man ngag gi rim pa mi 'dra ba gnyis/ yang slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa bdun pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta shar+dhā ka ras mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/

gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ yang dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shākya gshin rje gyis mdzad pa/ yang stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ kye rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs tā ra shrīs mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs/ de'i cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyis rdo rjes mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams so/ /lha 'di dag gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bham̐ ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ go tam shrī/ kīrti paṇ+ḍi ta/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ ka bcu ba gzhon nu seng ge bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal tshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen pa/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ bcom ldan ral gri/ 'ong chung ba bsam gzhon/ re steng pa byang dpal/ bla ma mgon po 'bum man gong du smos pa dang 'dra'o/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍheṃ gi pa/ an+tar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phaṃ thing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa/ gcung dus 'khor ba/ klog kya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/

zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog 'phel/ des sa skya lo rtsā ba la'o/ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ /grags pa/ paṇa chen/ skyo ston dri med/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyan mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ di paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ wa yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ lce sgom 'phags pa/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyag ston chos kyi shes rab/ chos rje ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge 'gro mgon shangs pa tshul khrims 'bum/ gnyag ston chen po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ nam mkha' dbang phyug nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /yang mus chen la/ chos rje bsod nams seng ge bas gsan/ de la bla mas kyang gsan no/ /sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga bla ma skyer sgang pas zhal gzigs dus kyi bstod pa rnams dang / rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms gnyis kyi rjes gnang yang thob/ /rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ shrār+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/

brag stengs pa/ mal lo/ /sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog des bdag la'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ paṇ+ḍi ta r+dharmā pā la/ lo chen/ brag stengs pa/ mal lo/ /sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug rat+nawar+dha/ des bdag la'o/ /yang las mgon pu tra'i zur dka' rgyas pa lcam sring lnga dang bsdus pa ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni gong lha brgyad dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud kyi bshad bka' thob pa la/ 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa gong ma'i sa bcad/ dka' 'grel mu tig phreng ba/ de'i bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ rje btsun chen po'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shri dz+wa lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya ba/ mal lo/ /sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug chos rje rat+na war+dha/ des bdag la'o/ /bka'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos thob pa'i tshul ni/

thog mar dpal kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa lugs kyi skor la/ bdud rtsi 'od/ lhan cig skyes grub/ tshogs 'khor 'du ba bsgrag pa/ de nyid bcu pa rnams ḍoṃ bi bas mdzad pa/ phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs a la la badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ dran pa gcig pa gar+bha ri pas mdzad pa/ bdag med ma dpa' gcig bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ gur gyi sgrub thabs/ bzang po yong bzung / yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs gtor chog 'grel pa ku mu ti rnams mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ rin chen 'bar ba grub chen dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nas gling ma/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ bstod pa nyi shu pa/ 'grel pa pad+ma can rnams mtsho skyes kyi skor/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba/ phyag bcu drug pas dpa' gcig phyag gnyis pa dpa' gcig rab gnas tshul zab mo/ /sbyin sreg ro sreg gshin gyi cho ga mchod rten gyi cho ga tshogs 'khor/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung / 'di rnams nag po pa'i skor ro/ /yang skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad/ rdzogs rim thig le chen po/ phyag rgya bzhi pa dze tā ris mdzad pa rnams thos/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa pad+ma can rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ shong 'gyur gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rin chen mtsho/ chos rje dpal/ mdo sde 'bar/ g.yung phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ nyi ma'i zhabs/ bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin rnam/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ des sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /lu hi pa'i sgrub thabs dpal mngon par rtog pa/ lo chen gyis bsgyur la/ 'gos dang mar dos bcos pa/ de'i 'grel pa rngog gi 'gyur/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga dang / lag mchod gnyis dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/

gtor ma'i cho ga rngog gi 'gyur/ de bzhi pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa ste lū hi pa'i smad lngar grags pa'ang thos so/ /yang nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog lo chen gyi 'gyur la/ 'gos kyis bcos pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dge slong rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur te/ bskyed rim skor gsum dang / rdzogs rim skor gsum ni dpyid kyi thig le mar do'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba 'gos 'gyur la mar dos bcos pa/ o la pa ti grags mchog shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams thos so/ /dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mal 'gyur/ dkyil chog chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rim lnga blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams thos/ gsang 'dus lugs gsum gyi yig cha'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la thog mar/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang / mdo bsre gnyis klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ lo chen 'gyur/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa/ klu'i blos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/ dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba sa paṇa gyi 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod mchog gnyis nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ klog kya gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems 'grel rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ pa tshab kyis bcos pa/ ya ra la wa sogs tshul bzhir bshad pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ lo chen gyi 'gyur/ rdzogs rim zab mo rim pa lnga'i gzhung klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa las/ rim pa gnyis pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rim pa lnga pa'i don 'grel spyod bsdus sgron ma dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa 'gos 'gyur/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong nag tsho'i 'gyur/

rim pa khongs su bsdu ba klu byang gis mdzad pa ban+dhe nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'gos kyi stong 'thun chen po rnams 'phags lugs kyi skor ro/ /ye shes zhabs lugs kyi skor la/ ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun bzang lo chen gyi 'gyur/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa ban+dhe dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal zhal lung ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa dman zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ grol ba'i thig le bdag sgrub pa ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ grol ba'i thig le'i 'grel pa slob dpon dman pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rnams lo chen gyis 'gyur thos so/ /pha rol du phyin pa'i mdo dang gzhung lugs thos pa ni/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ /sman bla'i mdo brgyad brgya pa/ mdo'i cho ga bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las mi g.yo bar bstan pa'i mdo/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa'i mdo/ rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa'i mdo/ 'phags pa sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhus pa'i chos bdun pa'i mdo/ chos bzhi pa'i mdo/ 'di rnams ban+dhe ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i blo gros kyi mdo dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs bcad/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mchod rten bskor ba'i mdo/ ltung ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu rnam par gzhag pa'i mdo/ kun tu rgyu sen rings kyi zhus pa'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen brten pa'i mdo/ sems bskyed kyi mdo/ chos spyod bcu'i mdo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo/ yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo ste lung sil bu bcu bdun du grags pa dang /

de rnams kyi bsdus don mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang thos so/ /rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung thob pa la thog mar sa skya pa chen po'i bka' 'bum thob pa'i rnams grangs ni/ rgyud sde spyi rnam/ brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ brtag gnyis kyi tshig 'grel/ dka' 'grel/ ṭīka chung man ngag don gsal/ gur gyi tho yig gur gyi bshad pa'i chings/ rdo rje'i glu'i bshad pa/ bsdus don/ rtsa'i mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa'i dka' 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel gyi yig sna/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes gyi sa bcad/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lo rgyus/ mtsho skyes kyi bshad pa tshig bcad ma/ gur gyi rgyud kyi zin bris/ sam+pu ṭa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag rgyud phyi ma'i bshad pa gnyis/ sam+pu ṭa rdor dbyings kyi dkyil chog kyai rdo rje'i gdan gyi rnam dag sngon 'byung gi rnam 'phrul ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa'i de nyid bcu pa'i dka' 'grel/ kag chol gyi sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'grel/ sa bcad/ dka' 'grel/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi yig sna/ 'di the tshom can yin gsungs/ nag po gzhung drug gi ṭī ka dang man ngag nag 'bum du grags pa la/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lo rgyus/ gzhung drug spyi'i rnam gzhag dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba/ o la pa ti/ dpyid thig rnams kyi sa bcad re re/ ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog mngon rtogs kyi gsal byed/ sbyin sreg gi ṭī ka de'i lag len/ ro sreg gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i ṭī ka de'i tshig don bsdus pa'i go 'byed/ o la pa ti'i rnam bshad/ o la pa ti'i man ngag dpyid thig gi ṭī ka 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭī ka sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'am bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog

man ngag gces bsdus su grags pa la/ bir+wa pa'i sgrub thabs sogs man ngag gi rnam grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug phyogs gcig tu bris pa/ gur gyi khro bcu'i gdams pa/ bha ya na'i man ngag bla ma skyu ra a skyabs la zhu yig bum gter gzhug tshul gyi man ngag rnams so// ༈ /slob dpon rin po che'i gsung 'bum thob pa la/ rje sa skya pa chen po la bstod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rgya sgom tshul khrims grags la springs yig slob dpon cha pa la bstod pa/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag chos rje pas zhus dag mdzad pa/ brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ saṃ pu ṭa'i sa bcad ṭī ka gnad kyi gsal byed/ gnyis pa'i rab byed gnyis pa'i ṭī ka sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi ṭī ka nas gling ma'i lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i dbang chog las dang po ba'i bya ba/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka'i lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung gi rab gnas dang / sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i ṭī ka kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ dbang gi chu bo/ /rab gnas bzang drug zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba'i ṭī ka gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa'i ṭī ka dang sa bcad/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub skor/ don yod zhags pa'i lo rgyus/ don zhags rgyud chung gi sa bcad/ lha lnga'i bstod pa/ don yod zhags pa'i mdo'i 'grel ba/ rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag chos drug mi g.yo ba sngon po'i chos skor gdam ngag dang bcas pa/ de la nye bar mkho ba'i srung 'khor gyi rgya gzhung / gtor chen gyi cho ga spyod 'jug gi ṭī ka chos la 'jug pa'i sgo byis pa bde lag tu 'jug pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi ṭī ka mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla chen mal dang / rje sa skya pa chen po gnyis ka'i slob ma rje btsun sku mched gnyis ka'i slob dpon bla ma gnyan phul byung bas mdzad pa rnams dang //

༈ /rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab la/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rje sa chen gyi rnam thar/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭī ka tshar gsum khug pa'i man ngag brtag gnyis kyi rnam bshad dag ldan/ rgyud gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa rin po che ljon shing / stong thun sa bcad/ gur gyi sa bcad/ rgyud sde'i dum bu brgya bcu gsum pa/ 'grel pa gur rgyan/ gur gyi thig chog kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rdo rje dril bu dang / bgrang phreng gi de nyid/ dga' ston rdo rje grags la gdams pa/ rgyud 'bum gyi dkar chag bla ma gong ma'i chos skor gyi dkar chag dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga rin chen 'bar ba'i sa bcad/ dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan phan bdud rtsi/ kyai rdo rje'i bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa kyai rdo rje'i bkra shis/ he ru ka'i byung tshul/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi sa bcad 'khrugs can dang 'khrugs med gnyis/ nag po pa'i sgrub thabs dang sbyin sreg gi sa bcad re/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi 'grel ba/ dkyil chog lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ dril bu ba'i lo rgyus/ dril bu ba'i sgrub thabs/ rim lnga'i ṭī ka tshes bcu'i mchod pa bya tshul/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi de nyid byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba'i rdzogs rim/ las bcu'i gsal byed/ mai tri mkha' spyod brgyud kyi dum bu/ sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad/ rjes gnang gi cho ga rgyal ba sdes mdzad pa 'di gsum rje btsun gyis mdzad pa min kyang / phyogs gcig bsgrig mkhan dang / mchan dang zin bris phreng re ba 'di rnams mdzad mkhan rje btsun yin pas 'dir bris so/

/nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ phyi mchod mdor bsdus byed tshul/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg pra dbab pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ 'di rnams rje sa chen gyi yin pas/ gong du 'dri rgyu yin na'ang phag mo skor gsum gyi man ngag phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir/ snga ma rnams kyis 'dir bris pa bzhin bzhag go /rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig nges brjod bla ma'i 'khor lo bri ba'i gdams ngag rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud kyi bsdus don/ ṭī ka ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs/ dgra nag gi mngon rtogs/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gdams ngag sgrol ma zhi khro'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs/ las kha tshar ba dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma spyi sgrub/ so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang / phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs kyi ṭī ka de'i sa bcad/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ 'chims chos seng ge don tu mdzad pa/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad/ mchan dkyus su bcug pa gsal ba'i 'od zer/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs/ rje btsun gyi mnal lam khams pa sba ston gyis bris pa/ nang gi lhung bzed brtag pa/ rje btsun gyi gsung bzhin rba ro'i ban+dhe bshes gnyen grags kyis zin bris byas pa/ ga rings rgyal po la brtsis bsdur du bskur ba he ru ka'i chas drug gis bshad pa/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa 'khrul spong / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la gzhung dgu bcu go drug yod pa'i ṭīka chung spyi'i rnam gzhag sa bcad dang bcas pa la sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i yig sna zhes grags pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi spyi don/ sbyong rgyud gyi sa bcad/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī ka kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan 'od zer/

cho ga bsdus pa gzhan phan nyer mkho/ arga'i cho ga rab gnas don gsal/ rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil chog dpal bo gcig grub kyi rgyud kyi ṭī ka mi g.yo ba sngon po'i bstod pa 'thad ldan/ 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ 'di sngon gyi dpe rnying gcig la/ rje btsun rtse mos mdzad bya ba snang ste/ de dag pa yin no/ /a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'di sing ha shrī zer ba gcig gi byas par snang kyang / ma dpe na bris pa bzhin 'dir shor ba yin no/ /a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dkyil chog don yod zhags pa'i cho ga maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga bstod pa/ srung 'khor bri tshul/ lag na rdo rje'i gzungs kyi man ngag rnam 'joms kyi rgyud kyi ṭī ka dang / bsdus don the tshom can/ dpung bzang kyi rgyud kyi dka' gnas kyi tho yig dran pa nyer gzhag sogs sbyar ba/ mkha' lding gi man ngag mi g.yo ba gsang rgyud le'u bzhi pa'i man ngag gtor chen don lnga'i cho ga 'di rje btsun rtse mo'i gtor chen dang mi mthun pas min pa 'dra na'ang snga ma rnams kyis bris pa bzhin bzhag go /gtor ma brgya rtsa btang tshul/ shākya'i rgyal rabs/ bod kyi rgyal rabs/ rgya bod kyi dge 'dun gyi gyes mdo/ dus tshod bzung ba'i rtsis yig gza' skar 'phrod mi 'phrod brtag pa/ zhe sa dgu phrugs kyi yi ge phyag rgya chen po gces bsdus zhes bya ba/ bla ma so so'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la phyag rgya chen po gnyis med 'od gsal ba la sogs pa man ngag sum cu tham pa/ chos spyod rin chen phreng ba/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad/ spyod 'jug gi sa bcad/ ye shes rdo rje la gdams pa'i nyams dbyangs/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag khams bde dri ba'i don gyi nyams dbyangs/ sa skya'i gnas la bstod pa'i nyams dbyangs/ gnyen po bsten tshul gyi nyams dbyangs/

rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs/ sgrub pa nyams su len tshul/ sems 'dul tshul gyi nyams dbyangs/ gsang sngags nang gi nyams len/ rang la rang gis bskul ba/ nyams dbyangs chen mo/ /'di gling ras kyi zur za chen mo la bcos nas/ gzhan zhig gi byas pa yin nam gsung ngo / sman spyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces grags pa'i sman spyad kyi gdams ngag chen mo 'di/ sman yan lag brgyad pa'i man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub nas lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i bar du rim par brgyud de bla ma mal lo tsā ba chen po las byung ba'i man ngag rje sa chen/ rje btsun chen po dpal chen 'od po rnams kyi man ngag thor bur mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa yin pas/ dang po 'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag nas mthar mgo bcos kyis rnam gzhag gi bar la sman spyad 'thor spyad/ rten 'brel gyi gdams ngag rab tu mang po zhig bzhugs so/ /'di rnams kyi lung dang glegs baṃ dang po nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ma byung ba la bla ma dam pa dpal ldan seng ge'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du/ chos kyi rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje dang / dbus pa rin rgyal gnyis/ phyogs bcur btang ste lung su yod la zhus pa yin pas/ brgyud pa gong ma rnams ni/ gsan yig tu shes par bya zhing / mkhan po shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bka' 'bum la/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter/ rol mo'i bstan bcos/ blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams la dri ba'i tshul rtsom 'phro/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i rnam bshad/ sgra'i gnad kyi gnad bsdus pa/

byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa'i rnam bshad byis pa la phan pa/ yi ge'i sbyor ba/ sgra nye bar bsdu ba'i tshigs bcad/ tshig gi gter/ sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba/ rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar thun mong du grags pa/ nga brgyad rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed de'i lung sbyor/ thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba/ tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa 'grel/ rje btsun gyi bstod pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la zhu phrin/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la phrin du springs pa/ lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad dgos tshul/ rtogs ldan gcig gi dris lan/ zhang lo tsā ba la gdams pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la springs pa/ yang tshigs bcad gong 'og gnyis/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams dpal bde chen lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por gnyug mar gnas pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams la phul ba'i yi ge nyi ma 'bum la springs ba/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ brda don gsal ba/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge lam sbas bshad/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzhi bshad snying po don gsal/ tshogs 'khor 'bring po/ de la dgongs pa rdo rje gur gyi lung sbyor/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba/ a ra pa tsa na dang / rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rigs kyi rab dbye'i bshad sbyar/ sgra sgrub dum bu dgu pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i sa bcad/ gza' yum gyi mchod chog brtag gnyis kyi piṇ+ḍār tha/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i 'grel pa/ dri ma med pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba gdab pa/ bod yul la bsngags pa/ shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa/ thub pa'i bstod pa lhug pa/ bde bar gshegs pa khams gsum gyi mgon po la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa dgu ba/

'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa tshigs su bcad ba bcu gcig pa/ lha sa'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la rab tu bsngags pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i rnam bshad yi ge nyung ngu / bsam yas su 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan ri mor bris pa'i yi ge gur ston gyi zhus lan/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi sgom chen rnams la gdams pa/ rang gi bu slob rnams la springs pa/ do kor ba'i dris lan/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs drug btul ba'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa/ ba gor zhes bya ba'i sgra la drangs pa'i yi ge rta nag ri khud kyi rnga bo che la bstod pa/ gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi bsgom don/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can chag lo'i dris lan/ glo bo lo tsā ba la springs pa'i yi ge bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan/ yang dris lan mdor bsdus gcig snyi mo sgom chen la springs yig phyag rgya chen po yan lag bdun ldan gyi rtsa ba/ bsngo ba'i yon bshad rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ /byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan man gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum la/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ brtag gnyis gyi 'grel pa ku mu ti'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 'jigs byed brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed la spel ba gong 'og gnyis/ bla ma spyi'i bstod pa mu tig phreng ba/

chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis/ gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa rtse lngar sbyar ba/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa/ chos rje pa'i mtshan la spel ba'i bstod pa gnyis/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa bdun/ /thogs med sku mched sogs la bstod pa/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma/ mchog brgyad la bstod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'grel pa/ bla ma la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ chos rje pa'i rnam thar/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa me tog gi phreng ba/ lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi brgyud yig bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas 'tshal mdor ldebs pa/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud kyi bsdus don/ rgyud gyi mngon rtogs/ dag ldan chung ba/ spyi don gsal ba gur gyi le 'grel/ sam+bu ṭa'i bsdus don/ he ru ka'i yig brgya bzla ba'i man ngag kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs srung 'khor dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi drug gi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad sogs zhus pa'i lan/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu'i rjes la smon lam gdab tshul/ kyai rdo rje'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga dbang la 'jug pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba'i lag len/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len tshigs bcad ma/ kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ kyai rdo rje'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi bum pa/ de'i lung sbyor/ kyai rdo rje'i tshogs 'khor bsdus pa/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i mngon rtogs/ bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid yig 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor/ khro bcu'i bstod bskul/ seng ge'i mtha'i dris lan/ dris lan rnam nges/ dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan/ sde snod 'dzin pa grags rin gyi dris lan/

dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi mngon rtogs/ lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi/ nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa/ yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis 'das dus gsal ba'i sgron me/ de'i don yang dag par bsdus pa/ gdod ma'i dus gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag dang mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba/ rgyu ba gnyis pa zhes bya'i rtsis/ lo bdag gi rtsis nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid nyung dus bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa rin po che'i sgron me/ rgyal po jim gin gyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus kyi bstan rtsis/ bde mchog so so'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i sdom tshig bdag 'jug gi cho ga mngon rtogs sgrub thabs snying po/ mchod phreng kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin/ sbyin sreg gi sdoms nyer bdun pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa/ lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba/ yang de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags nā ro pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba bsdus pa/ lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bdag 'jug rim lnga'i khrid yig bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs yan lag bcu pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs jo sras phag 'ju'i don tu mdzad pa/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i cho ga bde mchog gi bkra shis kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa las/ de'i tshig rkang ma snyoms pa la sogs pa zhus dag dang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kha bskang ba/ rgyal bu jim gin dang / go go can la phul ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i mngon rtogs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs nā ro pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/

sgo 'tshams ma rnams la bstod cing bskul ba/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa/ de'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul rol pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus/ de'i tshogs 'khor/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil chog phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bla ma nyid kyi cong tor bsgyur ba/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab gsal/ mdor byas kyi bsdus don/ ye shes zhabs kyi rnam thar dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs rin po che'i phreng ba/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs/ de'i bdag 'jug rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang bcas pa/ yang 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs gong 'og gnyis/ de'i sbyin sreg 'jam dpal zhi khro rnam bar rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha lnga ma'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje'i gshed lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med rnam par rol pa tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ yang lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa cig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba'i rnam bshad dam tshig rab gsal/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don/ rab tu gnas pa'i phyag len mdor bsdus pa/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs/

tshe sgrub zab mo cig tshe dpag med kyi bstod pa pad+ma'i phreng ba/ tshe dpag med kyi bsgom thabs ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi byab srung sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ yang thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs gcig seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub thabs/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs stong mchod dang bcas pa/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi bsgom bzlas dang gzungs bklag thabs/ ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs dang bstod pa/ de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ skul byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa/ 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg de'i bstod pa rgyas pa/ spyan ma'i sgrub thabs/ gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs/ 'dod lha'i bstod pa/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'i tshigs bcad tshan pa gnyis/ srung ba lnga'i sngon 'gro/ srung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dang bsdus pa/ lha mo lnga la bstod pa/ srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi gtor ma sogs btang pa'i cho ga dbang bskur ba'i sngon 'gro byur bsal ba'i cho ga dbang bskur dngos/ de'i cho ga'i sdom tshig dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs/ rgyud sde'i dkar chag rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral spags sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa'i yi ge bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ mgon po dang lha mo'i bstod pa/ lcam dral gyi gtor chog bshags pa/

gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi nyin zhag phrug gcig la thugs dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa/ chab gtor/ klu gtor/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho/ snyan ngag rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba/ thub pa'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pa/ yang 'jam dpal la bstod pa nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba/ 'jam dpal la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bstod pa/ rtse lnga'i ri bo'i rtse mo so so'i rigs dang mthun par bstod pa/ a nan+da kīrti'i don du dpa' bo'i 'khor lo bris pa/ yang 'jam dbyang la bstod pa/ skyid grong gi 'phags pa a ti la mnal lam du bstod pa/ byams pa mgon po la bstod pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa/ chos spyod yan lag bcu pa las cung zad rgyas par spel ba/ yan lag bdun pa/ phyag mchod sdig bshags bsngo ba dang bcas pa/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa 'bring du bstan pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa bsdus ba yul skyong mgon po dpal bzang po'i don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag bo lod kyi don du mdzad pa/ yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bskur gyi bslab bya nyung 'dus rgyal po a rog che'i don du mdzad pa/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa/ de'i bsdus don theg pa chen po rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ yi ge'i phyi mo la spel ba/ de'i bsdus don/ shes bya rab gsal/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long / rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba/ rgyal bu maṃ ga la la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba/ rgyal bu mo no gan la springs yig theg pa che chung gi chos kyi rnam gzhag rgyal bu ho ko'i don du mdzad pa/

rgyal bu de gus bho ga la gdams pa/ rgyal bu the mur bho ga la gdams pa/ sgrub pa'i rim pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba dpon mo sun+dha ri'i don du mdzad pa/ rgyal bu jim gin la springs yig gsum/ a tsa ra la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig la bskur ba'i yi ge ye shes 'bum la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i thig le/ rig par smra ba grags bzang la springs pa/ bden gnyis rnam nges/ zab mo snang ba'i rab dbye/ phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'i man ngag yang de'i khrid yan lag bdun ldan/ yan lag bdun gyi gtam/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig la phyin ci log tu brtags pa dgag tshul/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don bsdus pa/ zab mo mdo lnga'i sa bcad/ rgyud bla ma'i sa bcad/ skyo ba'i gtam tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa/ ngan pa'i spyod tshul la khrel ba'i gtam/ theg pa'i rnam dbye mdor bsdus/ bsam gtan shes rab kyi dris lan/ byang chub lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i rim pa/ yang tshigs su bcad pa thur bu gcig dbus gtsang du chos 'khor bskor ba'i bka' yig dge bshes tsha rong pa la springs pa/ yang sdom brtson gcig la springs pa/ zab mo nyams su len tshul/ rgyal bu ji 'big de mur la springs pa/ yi gyang jus glegs baṃ bsgrub pa la bsngags pa/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i bka' yig rgyal bu a go dang rin chen pag shi la springs pa/ bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣ+mīṃ ka ra dang / shong ston la bskur ba'i bka' yig rwa dbon la bskur ba/ ral gri la springs pa/ spyi bo lhas pa la bskur ba/ chag lo la bskur ba/ chos 'khor phyi ma'i dus su dbus gtsang gi mtshan nyid pa spyi/ dbus kyi bka' gdams pa spyi/ stag lung ba/ dbus kyi sgom chen pa spyi la bskur ba'i sh+lau ka re re/ rgyal bu ji 'big de mur la bskur ba'i springs yig gsum/ dpon mo du gal ngur mig la bskur ba'i yi ge gnyis/

yang tshigs bcad thor bu ba gcig rgyal bu jim gin/ ho ko grags bzang / ston gzhon rnams la springs yig re re/ gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i dus kyis mchod brjod dang bsngo ba/ tshe dpag med kyi bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig tshigs bcad thor bu ba gnyis/ mgon g.yag la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad/ rgyal po jim gin gyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdebs sbyor gyi rgyan rnams par bkra ba/ yang rgyal bu jim gin gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa la bsngags pa gnyis/ rgyal bu maṃ ga las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / phal po che bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rgyas bu ji 'big de mur gyi phal po che/ gser 'od dam pa stong phrag brgya pa rnams bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rgyal bu a rog ches 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rgyal bu go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyi rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rin chen dpal gyis 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ zin shing gi ston pa btul ba'i tshigs bcad/ theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dang slob ma'i lam nyams su blang tshul bstan pa/ las chog rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga rgyal po yab sras kyi mchod rten rin po che bzhengs pa la bsngags pa'i sdebs sbyor daṇ+ḍa ka bsngags par 'os pa la bsngags pa'i rab byed/ rgyal rabs la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad/ gsan yig rgyal po go bo la sras dang btsun mor bcas pa la shing mo yos/ me pho 'brug me mo sbrul/ sa pho rta/ lcags mo bya/ chu pho khyi/ chu mo phag shing pho byi ba/ shing mo glang / me mo yos/ sa pho 'brug sa mo sbrul/ lcags pho rta/ lcags mo lug chu pho spre'u/ chu mo bya/ shing pho khyi/ shing mo phag me pho byi ba/ me mo glang / sa pho stag

sa mo yos/ lcags pho 'brug rnams kyi/ lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe phul ba'i bkra shis kyi phreng ba nyi shu rtsa gsum/ yang maṃ ga la yab yum/ ji 'big yab yum dpon mo chen mo rnams la bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad/ gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sh+lau ka gcig rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni 'phags pa rin po che/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ byang seng pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan man sngar dang 'dra'o// ༈ /rje btsun kun dga' bzang po pas mdzad pa'i gsung rab po ti bzhi bzhugs pa'i lung thos pa la thog mar/ bla ma spyi'i bstod pa/ sdom gsum brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ lo chen rin chen bzang po la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig sa skya pa chen po la bstod pa/ chos rje shar pa la bstod pa lnga/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ mkhan chen bkra shis rin chen rnams la bstod pa/ gsang 'dus rim lnga mgos lugs/ 'jigs byed kyi rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ shin tu spros med/ bde mchog rim lnga/ rtsa dbu ma'i ring brgyud/nye brgyud/ bde mchog dkar po'i man ngag lam zab/ lam 'bras/ bsam mi khyab/ lhan cig skyes grub/ mchod rten drung thob/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa/ pad+ma badz+ra'i lam/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po bsrang ba/ in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam ma hā mā ya'i rdzogs rim/ spyod 'jug zhen pa bzhi bral rnams kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sher phyin dkar mo/ /phyag rdor 'chi 'joms/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ 'dod rgyal/ tshogs bdag dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrungs rnams la bstod pa re re/ las dang po pa'i nyams len yan lag bdun pa/ sa paṇa/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam thar/ chos rje nyid kyi gsan yig rgyud gsum gnod 'joms/

de'i 'grel pa/ lus dkyil rtsod spong lta ba ngan sel dang smra ba ngan 'joms/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa mtshams bshad pa/ lam 'bras chos 'byung rtsom 'phro/ lam 'bras bshad thabs kyi man ngag rgyud gsum lam rim gyi sa bcad/ rgyud dus kyi dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed/ lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bir srungs bar chad kun sel/ bir+wa pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bir srung gi byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i nyams len/ de dang lam 'bras mtshan mtshon sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi byung tshul dang brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi sngar gyi 'gyur la ma byung ba'i sh+lau ka gnyis rgya dpe gsum la gzigs nas rje nyid kyis bsgyur ba/ kyai rdo rje rtsa bshad kyi rgya bod kyi 'grel pa'i rnam grangs/ ḍoṃ bi lugs kyi kyai rdor gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa/ 'phrin yig dbang po'i rdo rje/ bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ gtor chog gi 'grel pa 'phrin las rgyas byed/ mtsho skyes dang / ḍoṃ bi lugs gnyis kyi bsgrub dkyil gyi tho yig gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par gzhag pa/ bskyed rim dang / lam dus len tshul gyi sdom tshig mngon rtogs tshul bcu bzhi'i sdom tshig sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi maṇ+ḍal mchod mchog 'dod rgyal kyi sgrub thabs/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur gyi sbyin sreg gar gyi shan 'byed/ sangs rgyas kyi gar/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma'i stang stabs/ chos skyong gi man ngag gi dkar chag gur lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / dpal sa skya'i bka' srungs rnams kyi gtor chog gtor sgrub kyi man ngag thugs dam bskang ba/ kyai rdo rje bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ sam+bu ṭa rdor dbyings kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog
