mchod phreng / dkyil chog sbyin sreg bkra shis/ tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun rgyan/ tshogs 'khor kun bzang rnam rol/ bde mchog bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang rnam gzhag ril bu la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje lha mo'i tshe bsgrub/ la ba pa'i bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs kyi tho/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i mngon rtogs kyi tho/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sngags phreng mchan ma/ mchod phreng / dkyil chog gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ de'i shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad par/ rim lnga'i khrid yig rtsom 'phro/ gtor chog mchod phreng / rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog dkyil chog sbyin sreg rab gnas/ bkra shis/ phreng gar/ dgra nag gi char 'bebs/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi rdzogs rim/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon rtogs/ dag pa/ lung sbyor/ spros med mdzes rgyan/ dkyil chog kun rig dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan phan mtha' yas/ rdul tshon kha bskong / cha gsum gtor ma/ spyod rgyud spyi rnam/ bya rgyud spyi rnam/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes 'dzin/ 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil chog dri med lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bsgom bzlas/ gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor gyi sngags la zhu dag mdzad pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / tshe bsgrub kyi man ngag seng ge sgra/ sna tshogs yum/ rma bya chen mo/ /so sor 'brang ma/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ rta mgrin nag po rnams kyi sgrub thabs chung du re re/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod chog dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed rang gis blang ba'i cho ga mchod sbyin chen mo'i zin bris/

gser sku rdo rje 'chang du byed tshul/ rags sdom bcu'i 'bru 'grel bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mdor bsdus gcig sngags kyi bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mtshan nyid kyi bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag springs yig slob ma la phan pa/ sa bzang po bsod nams dpal gyi dris lan gnyis/ lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal/ dge 'dun mgon/ a mo gha/ bla chen chos rin pa/ gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsam bzang gi dris lan/ dbu ma pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ mdo stod pa dge bzang gi dris lan gnyis/ sde snod 'dzin pa rat+na shrī la gdams pa/ gsang ba kun dga' gzhon nu la gdams pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gdams pa gnyis/ byang chub bsod nams rin chen la gdams pa sh+lau ka gcig rgyal rong ba bkra shis dpal la gdams pa/ sgrub pa po blo bzang la gdams pa gnyis/ nyag re sangs rgyas grags la gdams pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la springs pa/ bal yul ye rang gi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma no bo dhi yab sras la springs pa/ dpon po rgyal mtshan dpal yab yum sras la springs pa/ ya tshe rgyal po hasti rā dza yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ de'i blon po la gdams pa sh+lau ka gcig a ya dbang phyug bkra shis la gdams pa/ dpon rgan thar pa ye shes la gdams pa/ slob dpon bzod pa la bstod pa/ phyi nang gi yas gtam/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ gser 'od dam pa las btus pa'i smon lam rnams thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /yang na sems dpa' chen po chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje las kyang gsan no// ༈ /rgyal ba'i sras po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'dren mchog chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung 'bum rnams thos pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/

rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa gsum/ sdom gsum brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong snga rting gnyis/ gsung ngag sogs kyi gsol 'debs kyi kha skong tshan pa lnga/ chos rje rgyal mchog pa la bstod pa gnyis/ dkon mchog gsum bstan srung dang bcas pa dang / mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ khri srong lde btsan/ jo bo rje rnams la bstod pa re/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i rnam thar/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rnam thar/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gsung ngag gi zin bris gnyis/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ gtor chog lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang blang tshul snga rting gnyis/ ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog dbang chu'i sa chog gi lag len sta gon so shing sogs kyi dgos pa/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi bskyed rim gyi grub mtha'i rnam dbye/ de'i 'phros cung zad cig dril bu lus dkyil gyi zin bris/ lo nag dril gsum rim pa bzhin nyams su blang tshul/ nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ngag 'don/ lo nag dril gsum gyi bum bskyed/ bde gshegs sa bzung / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dkyil chog gi zin bris/ 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gyi zin bris/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa dang / tshe bsgrub kyi man ngag sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtsho'i gsan yig gtsug tor dri med kyi cho ga'i lag len/ tsha tsha'i rab gnas bsdus pa/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/ gdams pa thor bu ba'i skor la/ rang la rang gis gros 'debs/ bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la gnang ba'i bka' shog bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang la gnang ba'i bka' shog dang gdams pa tshan bzhi/ bla ma blo rin la gdams pa/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'i bka' shog bla ma rin chos la gdams pa/ dpon po kun dga' chos skyong la gdams pa/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o// ༈ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i bka' 'bum gyi lung thob pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ bla ma rin 'byung gi gsol 'debs/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i bstod pa gnyis/ rje mus chen gyi rnam thar gyi rtsa tshig kha skong dang bcas pa/ de'i 'grel pa/ bdag chen chu mig pa/ chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ gung ru/ go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal rnams la bstod pa re re/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa gnyis/ kyai rdo rje 'grel pa lugs dang / bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong re re/ phar tshad brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ phar tshad kyi mchod yar/ byams pa/ sgrol ma/ gur mgon rnams la bstod pa re re/ zab don bdud rtsi snying khu rtsa 'grel/ lam 'bras khrid rim dang mthun pa'i smon lam/ dbang bzhi'i smon lam/ bla ma mchod chog brda' 'grol nges pa'i dpal ster/ a seng ma'i 'grel pa/ lam 'bras chos 'byung / snang ba gsum gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin 'bri ba'i lam gyi rnam gzhag bdag med ma'i mngon dkyil gyi tho/ lam dus kyi dbang bskur gso dang / bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs byed tshul/ mngon rtogs tshul bcu bzhi'i nyams len/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor/ gzhal yas khang sgo rkyang / sbrag gi khyad par/ zla zer/ rtsod spong / rab gnas dge legs rgyal mtsho/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ lus dkyil gyi rnam bshad bde chen bcud kyi snying po/ dbang chu chen mo'i sa chog gi gsal byed/ dbang chu'i rnam bshad bde chen rgya mtsho/ gur gyi sgrub dkyil/ sam+bu ṭa'i cho ga'i gsal byed/ rgyud kyi bsdus don tshigs bcad ma/ mtsho skyes phra mig rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs byed tshul/

bde mchog chos 'byung / lo nag gi mngon rtogs/ bde mchog rnam bshad/ rim bzhi'i khrid yig mkha' spyod sgo 'byed/ rdo rje theg pa la log smra tshar gcod pa rigs pa'i mtshon cha/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil/ de dang spyan ras gzigs kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'jam rdor gyi gtor chog mchod phreng / sgrub thabs kun bzang nyi 'od kyi don 'grel/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub dkyil/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul la grangs nges phye ba/ gzhan phan 'od zer gyi rtsod spong / kun rig gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sbyong rgyud kyi ṭī ka 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul/ sdom gsum kha skong / de'i sa bcad dris lan pad+mo'i bzhad pa/ nyi zla seṅge/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang rat+na shrī/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgrub pa tshul khrims bzang po/ 'dan ma sher seng / rin chen byang chub/ 'dan ma tshe rgyal skyabs rnams kyi dris lan re/ rtags 'jug gi ṭī ka smon lam chen po bcu pa/ yang smon lam chen po bcu pa/ bsngo ba mdor bsdus/ sog po ka bcu pa/ drung chen kun spangs pa/ go bo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams la gdams pa re/ bdag chen blo gros pa/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta/ karma ba mi 'pham mgon po/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa/ slob dpon sbyin bzang / chums bde chen gyi mkhan po rnams la bstod pa re re/ gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bris sku'i dkar chag gser sku'i dkar chag sa chen gyi bris sku chen mo'i dkar chag bde ba can gyi smon lam/ mdo khams su 'bul bsdud kyi phyag rtags/ gyad gnyer dge gsum la dge bskul btang ba'i yi ge sdom gsum rab dbye'i spyi don/ ṭī ka sa bcad/ sdom gsum dris lan rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel ba/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la gnang ngo //

༈ /chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pas mdzad pa'i lam dus kyi dbang bskur tshul dang gso chog yi ge brgya pa dang / aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung gi yi ge rnams kyang thos so/ /bde mchog lū hi pa dang / nag po pa'i mchod phreng ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ gshed dmar dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba rnams rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel ba nyid kyis mdzad pa thos shing / byams pa'i smon lam gyi lung yang thos so/ /bslab pa kun las btus pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur gyi steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ār+ya shan+ta da sha ya 'phags pa zhi ba lha/ e la dha ri pā ya/ dpal dpa' bo'i sde/ shrī bī ra se nā ya/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa sau war+ṇaṇa dwi pa dhar+m+ma kīrta ye/ dpal ldan ches phul du byung ba mar me mdzad shrī mān+ma hā a ti shā ya/ dza yā ka rā ya rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'brom ston/ rat+na pra kā shā ya rin chen gsal pu to ba/ gu ṇa kīrta ye yon tan grags pa sha ra ba/ pradz+nyā kīrta ye shes rab grags chu mig pa/ a mṛ ta kīt+ta ye bdud rtsi grags pa gro ston/ ga ga na kīrta ye nam mkha' grags mchims/ u pā dhā ya kī rti bīr+yā ya mkhan po grags pa brtson 'grus/ kīrti pradz+nyā ya grags pa shes rab/ su ma ti kīrta ye blo bzang grags pa mchims/ ā nan+da dh+wa dzā ya kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sid+dha pradz+nyā ya grub pa shes rab sad ston/ pradz+nyā sa mu trā ya shes rab rgya mtsho/ bha ṭ+ṭa rā ka rat+na war+dha rje btsun dkon mchog 'phel/ bhū mi paṇ+ḍu lo tsā mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da pu ṇ+ye kī rti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre ṇa shru tisma sa skya lo tsa ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la'o/

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur gyi steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ zhi ba lha/ paṇ+ḍi ta mi brjed gzungs thob/ je tā ri/ zla ba grags pa/ puṇ+ya shrī/ bal po ka na ka shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti kīt+ti/ rngog lo/ /slob dpon blo gros 'byung gnas/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge gtsang nag pa/ dpal ldan gro/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ ze'u grags pa brtson 'grus/ grags pa shes rab/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ mkhan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sad ston grub pa shes rab/ mgar ston shes rab rgya mtsho/ rje dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung thob pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ thog mar byang chub lam gyi sgron me/ lo tsā ba dge blo'i 'gyur/ spyod bsdus sgron me nag tsho'i 'gyur/ bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ dbu ma'i man ngag nag tsho'i 'gyur/ snying po bsdu ba dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis 'gyur/ snying po nges par bsdu ba nag tsho'i 'gyur/ byang sems nor bu'i phreng ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa/ 'di gnyis la 'gyur byang mi snang / 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i glu rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur la nag tshos bcos pa/ spyod pa'i glu dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings su blta ba'i glu dran pa gcig pa'i man ngag byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i lam la 'jug par bstan pa rnams nag tsho'i 'gyur/ skyabs su 'gro ba bstan pa 'gyur byang med pa/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ger bsdus pa dge blo'i 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa dge blo'i 'gyur/ rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskul ba dang bcas pa yi ger bris pa mdzad pa de dge blo'i 'gyur/

mdo sde'i don kun las btus pa'i man ngag mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa/ las rnam par 'byed pa rnams nag tsho'i 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga kha ton dang glegs baṃ klog pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga pha rol tu phyin pa'i tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa 'di bzhi la 'gyur byang mi snang / sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa dge blo'i 'gyur/ 'di yan jo bo rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa puṇ+ḍa shrī mi tra dang / dar ma grags kyi bsgyur/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / yi dam blang ba'i cho ga dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ su ma ti kīrti dang / blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ las dang po ba'i sa sbyang ba dgra las rnam rgyal gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ dkriṣ+ṇa pa dang / chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ sems rin po che sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i phrin yig dgra las rgyal ba'i gsang bas mdzad pa/ ā tsar+ya du lo pa dang / chos she'i 'gyur/ bshes pa'i springs yig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ slob ma la springs yig tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang / dpal brtsegs kyi bsgyur/ rgyal po ka ni ka la springs yig ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ bi rgya ka ra pra bha ba dang / rin chen mchog gi 'gyur la/ ā tsar+ya dpal brtsegs kyis bcos pa/ dri ma med pa'i dris lan rin po che'i phreng ba/ rgyal po chen po snyan ngag mkhan la gdams pa slob dpon don yod 'char kyis mdzad pa/ ka ma la gup+ta dang rin chen bzang po'i bsgyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la springs pa'i yi ge sarba dz+nyā de ba dang /

dpal brtsegs kyi bsgyur/ shes rab brgya pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang dpal brtsegs kyi bsgyur/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ dhar+m+mā ka ra dang / gtsang de wen+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ a dzit+ta shrī bha drwa dang / shākya 'od kyi bsgyur/ dge ba bcu'i lam bstan pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa bud+dhā ka ra warma dang / chos she'i bsgyur/ mya ngan bsal ba rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ a dzit+ta shrī bha dra dang / shākya 'od kyi bsgyur/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ gsang ba byin gyis mdzad pa bsgyur byang med pa/ yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ ga ga dha ra dang rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshul khrims kyi gtam dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ dza ran dha na dang rin chen bzang po'i bsgyur/ tshogs kyi gtam dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ ga ga dha ra dang rin chen bzang po'i bsgyur/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ shrī a dzit+ta bha dra dang / shākya 'od kyi bsgyur/ legs par bshad pa rin po che za tog lta bu'i gtam dpa' bos mdzad pa ru tra dang shākya 'od kyi bsgyur/ phyin ci log bzhi spang ba'i gtam ma ti tsi dras mdzad pa/ bud+dha bha drwa dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam ma ti tsi dras mdzad pa/ a dzit+ta shrī bha dra dang shākya 'od kyi bsgyur/ dben pa'i gtam chos byin gyis mdzad pa/ dī paṃ ka ra dang dge blo'i bsgyur/ rin chen phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad nyi shu pa/ ba tshwa'i chu klung gi mdo las 'byung ba'i sems can mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs bcad bcu gnyis pa/ bud+dha ka ra warma dang chos kyi shes rab kyi bsgyur/ smon lam bdun cu pa/ gzhan la phan pa'i dbyangs dgon pa bas mdzad pa dharma shrī pra bha ba dang lhun po'i sde'i bsgyur/

don dam par byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i rim pa dang / kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi bsgom pa'i rim pa gnyis/ rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ pad+ma ka ra warma dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ sangs rgyas rjes dran/ chos rjes dran/ dge 'dun rjes dran gsum mdo nas byung ba/ 'dod yon lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ dharma shrī bha dra dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ rtogs pa chen po'i cho ga mdo las gsungs pa'i sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga bslab btus nas phyung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsrung ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga mdo sngags gnyis kyi thun mong gi maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa bsgyur byang med pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga dgra las rnam rgyal gsang bas mdzad pa/ a du lo pa dang / chos kyi shes rab kyi bsgyur/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ dar ma grags kyi bsgyur/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rnyog med rdo rjes mdzad pa a du lo pa dang / blo ldan shes rab kyi bsgyur/ gsang sngags theg pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga kam pa las mdzad pa bsgyur rnying / ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u gnas brtan byang bzang gis mdzad pa/ bi nā ya tsan+d+ra dang chos she'i bsgyur/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u nag po pas mdzad pa/de nyid dang chos she'i bsgyur/ bsam gtan gyi chos drug a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa dā na shi las mdzad pa dharma shrī bha dra dang / rin bzang gi bsgyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam par gzhag pa/ hwa shang zab mo dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsgyur/ rnam par rtog pa'i gegs sel ba sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa bsgyur rnying / rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa byang bzang gis mdzad pa bsgyur med/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa la 'jug pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang ye shes sde'i bsgyur/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i lam ye shes snying pos mdzad pa bsgyur med/

rnal 'byor la 'jug pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa dharma shrī bha dra dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa'i rim pa dge ba'i go chas mdzad pa bsgyur rnying / lus yongs su dpyad pa'i bsgom pa'i rim pa nag po pas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang chos she'i bsgyur/ pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ pad+ma ka ra warma dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bla na med par bsgom pa ma hā ma tis mdzad pa/ bi nā ya tsan+d+ra dang chos kyi shes rab kyi bsgyur/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa dza ran+dha dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ shes phyin bsgom pa'i man ngag rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ shān+ti bha drwa dang 'gos bsgyur/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsgom pa'i don mdor bsdus de bstan pa/ ye shes zla bas mdzad pa/ pradz+nyā warma dang / ye shes sde'i bsgyurabade bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dze tā ris mdzad pa shān+ti bha drwa dang 'gos bsgyur/ yon tan bdun bstan pa'i gtam dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa ka ma la gusta dang / rin bzang gi bsgyur/ bslab btus kyi rtsa ba zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ bslab btus kyi mngon rtogs mar me mdzad dang / nag tsho'i 'gyur/ theg chen nyi shu pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ā nan+da dang grags 'byor shes rab kyi bsgyur/ sa lu ljang pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dharma shrī bha dra legs pa'i blo gros dang / dz+nyā na ku mā ra dang / dpal brtsegs kyi bsgyur/ rten 'brel snying po dang / de'i 'grel ba dang / rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam rnams klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ kha che shrī tha ra tha dang / grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems 'grel klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'gyur mang las tshig don gang bzang bris pa/ bla na med par bstod pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/

shākya 'od kyi bsgyur/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ de'i don bsdus phyogs glang gis mdzad pa gnyis/ sarba dz+nyā de ba dang rin chen mchog gi bsgyur/ srid pa las 'das pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ shrī tha ra tha dang grags 'byor shes rab kyi bsgyur/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i 'grel pa phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ khyad par 'phags bstod mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad pa/ lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa bde byed bdag pos mdzad pa rnams/ sarba dz+nyā de wa dang rin chen mchog gi bsgyur la/ dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ skyabs gsum bdun cu pa zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ dī paṃ ka ra dang rin bzang gi bsgyur/ skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa bi ma las mdzad pa/ dri ma med pa rin po che'i phrin yig dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ de nyid nag tsho'i 'gyur rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo/ 'brom ston pa/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ chu mig pa/ dpal ldan gro/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ yol ston bsod nams lhun grub/ slob dpon grags pa rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgyal mtsho/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs shes rab rgyal mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag la'o/ /bdun pa rab dga'i nang tshan gyi/ /gzhon nu rol pa'i sdeb sbyor yin/ tri rat+na ru paka twa/ dhi de bta tsa atā+e/ bshās na i rak+ṣi/ na ma thakṛ ti bi su l+yaṃ/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /lha pa'i lha dang gnyis med pa'i/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i phrin las gang / /'phel bar mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /de ltar rje btsun zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom pa gsum/ /dbang bskur rgyud dang man ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rna ba'i snod du lhung las snying gi dbus/
